headline: Rebuilding 90s Road Rash in pure Vanilla JS
text:
We rebuilt 90s Road Rash in a single vanilla JS file using pseudo-3D raster projection.

Pin the throttle, punch rivals into oncoming traffic, zero downloads:
https://kreeda.games/road-rumble/index.html

#gamedev #webdev #indiedev
mediaSuggestion: A 5-second 60fps looping gameplay GIF showing the player swinging a club at a rival biker, sending them crashing into an oncoming civilian truck over a crest hill.
